searchText: b"h boruch hashem blessed is he phase two — risk, gevurah, and improvement the awtsmoos gives each boundary strength, each vessel a rightful place; awtsmoos.com must remove collision, not disguise it with a brighter face. the first map names the road; this pass names where the road can break, so every claimed repair must carry proof no screenshot can fake. critique of the inherited state the earlier pass appears architecturally sound, but completion evidence is incomplete. static rewrites are not enough. the highest risk gap is that behavior has not yet been measured in the browser across the actual scroll vessel, overlays, network states, and viewport classes. the second risk is import closure: old css may remain active through recursive imports even when touched files are clean. the third risk is breadth: heichel and standalone social pages have not been exhaustively swept. improvements before implementation 1. read repository status before any source write and preserve unrelated edits. 2. search older heichel/mobile/post archaeology so prior known edge cases are not rediscovered blindly. 3. resolve auto scroll persistence through exported production storage key helpers, never version literals in tests. 4. test the production 45 wpm contemplate default instead of reviving stale 120 wpm expectations. 5. treat unit tests as contract evidence, not runtime movement evidence. 6. measure the owning scroll root directly before/start/after/pause/resume/stop. 7. verify both natural document scroll and a real inner .scroll view wrapper when such a route exists. 8. derive active css roots from awtsmoos.post.html, then recurse every @import before scanning. 9. classify conflicting css as active, dormant, legacy, dead, or compatibility rather than deleting historical files indiscriminately. 10. reject specificity escalation as a repair technique; move ownership instead. 11. trace community parameters from dom/runtime context into the actual request url before touching /comment tree. 12. inspect response status, body, server route, and logs so client and server failure are distinguishable. 13. keep failure and empty community states semantically different. 14. find main menu ownership from runtime selectors/controllers, not from filename guesses. 15. open every menu child view and verify back navigation and focus recovery. 16. exercise every visible scribe's lens control, including reset, pace presets, range, advanced, theme/font, and color controls. 17. test safe area and internal sheet scrolling at 390x844 and 430x932. 18. verify :focus visible with keyboard navigation, not visual css inspection alone. 19. emulate or inject reduced motion media state and confirm ambient/entrance motion collapses. 20. inventory every heichel user route from entry templates and bootstrap modules before deciding the sweep is complete. 21. include rtl/hebrew and ltr/english, long titles, loading, empty, and error cases in heichel verification. 22. inventory all social visible subsystems from real imports and runtime dom before adding more styling. 23. keep every social rule beneath .awtsmoos social root and test a reader route after social work for leakage. 24. run syntax checks on each rewritten js file immediately after the implementation batch. 25. run wc l on every touched source and split safe responsibilities rather than deleting documentation. 26. search console, failed network requests, csp, assets, and module errors on each important route. 27. after each apparent success, repeat the related regression search so success does not hide shadow work. 28. re read every touched file in full before the final delta. 29. record exact route, viewport, request result, and measured movement in durable final notes. 30. do not declare remaining work empty while any browser or network claim is inferred rather than observed. primary risk graph template css roots recursive imports duplicate owner geometry collision reader control auto scroll controller root resolver motion writer wrong vessel state changes without movement paragraph community context ids request builder comment tree route auth/data/server truthful error or tree menu trigger controller sheet geometry child views focus/back mobile usability social bootstrap index.css root scoped modules visible subsystem reader isolation remaining work
